definitions: The fleshy muscular organ in the mouth, used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and articulating speech.
A person's particular way of speaking.
A strip of leather or other material under the laces or buckles of a shoe.
A long, low promontory of land.
examples: He spoke in his native tongue.
The tongue of the bell was broken.
The tongue of the shoe was folded.
A tongue of land extended into the sea.
